blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Satellite-based 3D reconstruction is limited by sparse observations and changes across acquisition dates. Existing methods use generative priors to recover missing visual detail, but ghosting, streaking, and blur persist in their Gaussian scenes. These artifacts become particularly apparent in low-elevation renderings. We introduce CityRecast to suppress these artifacts through Gaussian scene repair and supervision calibration. To correct the Gaussian distributions that produce these artifacts, we first use multi-angle warm-up to constrain their spatial extent. This reduces the initial ghosting carried into progressive refinement. Surface-guided replacement then continues to repair the Gaussian distribution while preserving existing appearance. To provide more reliable supervision for this process, observation calibration mitigates interference from multi-temporal observations. Joint refinement further reduces conflicts among generated views. Experiments on DFC2019 and IARPA demonstrate reduced artifacts in low-elevation renderings while maintaining satellite-view fidelity. Compared with Skyfall-GS, CityRecast reduces FID-CLIP by 25.3% on DFC2019 and 51.8% on IARPA. MUSIQ increases by 14.54 and 24.95 points, respectively.
blocks.zh: 基于卫星的立体重建由于观测很少和采购日期的变化而受到限制。 现有的方法使用基因学前科来恢复缺失的视觉细节,但幽灵,花纹和模糊在高斯的场景中持续存在. 这些文物在低地外向渲染中变得特别明显. 我们引入CityRecast,通过高斯的场景修复和监督校正来压制这些文物. 为了纠正生产出这些文物的高斯分布,我们首先使用多角取暖来限制它们的空间范围. 这减少了最初的幽灵 被带入逐步完善。 然后由地表制导替换继续修复高斯分布,同时保留现有的外观. 为了对这一过程提供更可靠的监督,观测校正可以减轻多时观测的干扰. 联合改进进一步减少了所产生的意见之间的冲突。 在DFC2019和IARPA的实验中,演示出低穿行渲染过程中减少的文物,同时保持了卫星视忠. 与Skyfall-GS相比,CityRecast在DFC2019上将FID-CLIP减少了25.3%,在IRPA上减少了51.8%. MUSIQ分别增加了14.54分和24.95分.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reconstructing 3D urban scenes from sparse satellite imagery offers an important route to large-scale city modeling and free-viewpoint visualization [ 81 , 10 , 39 , 84 ] . However, limited viewing directions leave building facades weakly observed. Changes in scene content and appearance across acquisition dates further complicate reconstruction [ 39 , 13 , 1 ] . These difficulties become particularly apparent at low-elevation viewpoints unseen during training [ 29 ] . Reconstruction should therefore recover clear low-elevation views while preserving fidelity to the available satellite observations.
blocks.zh: 从稀少的卫星图像上重建3D城市场景,为大规模城市建模和自由取景可视化提供了重要通道[81,10,39,84]. 然而,有限的取景方向使得建筑外观被弱视. 购置日期的场景内容和外观的变化使重建进一步复杂化[39、13、1]。 这些困难在培训期间所看不到的低水平观点中特别明显。 因此,重建应恢复清晰的低纬度观点,同时保持对现有卫星观测的忠诚。

blocks.en: Multi-view stereo recovers scene geometry by matching satellite observations while accounting for their camera models [ 48 , 49 , 14 ] . More recently, neural radiance fields and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have enabled joint optimization of scene geometry and appearance through differentiable rendering [ 41 , 25 ] . Their satellite adaptations further account for illumination changes and transient observations [ 10 , 39 ] . However, satellite views still provide limited information about building facades. Generative priors offer a way to recover this missing appearance information [ 63 , 61 ] . Skyfall-GS brings this direction to satellite reconstruction by refining rendered views into additional supervision, enabling low-elevation urban exploration [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 多视立体通过匹配卫星观测来恢复场景几何,同时计算其相机模型[48,49,14]. 最近,神经发光场和3D高斯平板(3DGS)通过可分的渲染[41,25],使场景几何和外观得到联合优化. 它们的卫星改造进一步说明了照明的变化和瞬态观测[10,39]. 然而,卫星观测仍然对建筑外观提供的信息有限。 遗传学前科提供了一种恢复这一缺失外观信息的方法[63,61]. Skyfall-GS将这一方向引向卫星重建,方法是将观点改进为额外的监督,从而能够进行低海拔城市探索[29]。

blocks.en: Despite this progress, persistent artifacts remain in low-elevation renderings. Removing them requires addressing two challenges. • Misplaced or excessively elongated Gaussians can reproduce the input satellite views while producing ghosting and streaks from lower elevations. Sharper supervision does not necessarily correct their positions or spatial extent. Repeated fitting smooths some initial artifacts into blur, while others persist as ghosting or streaking. • Real and generated images can provide conflicting supervision for the same scene. Transient objects and cross-date appearance changes make real observations inconsistent, while independently refined views may contain incompatible structures. Fitting these targets can reinforce existing artifacts or introduce new ones.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这一进展,但持久性文物仍然处于低地外向渲染状态. 要消除这些挑战,就需要应对两个挑战。 • 位置被错位或时间过长的高斯人可以复制输入卫星视图,同时从低海平面产生幽灵和花纹。 更严格的监管不一定能纠正其位置或空间范围. 不断的装配使一些初始的文物变得模糊不清,而另一些则持续地作为"鬼魂"或"花花". • 真实的和生成的图像可为同一场景提供相互矛盾的监督。 瞬态对象和跨日期外观变化使得真实的观察不一致,而独立精炼的观察可能包含不相容的结构. 配合这些目标可以强化现有的文物或引进新的文物。

blocks.en: Misplaced or excessively elongated Gaussians can reproduce the input satellite views while producing ghosting and streaks from lower elevations. Sharper supervision does not necessarily correct their positions or spatial extent. Repeated fitting smooths some initial artifacts into blur, while others persist as ghosting or streaking.
blocks.zh: 错误或过长 高斯人可以复制输入的卫星视图,同时产生从下高地上走来走去的幽灵和花纹. 更严格的监管不一定能纠正其位置或空间范围. 不断的装配使一些最初的文物变得模糊不清,而另一些则持续地被鬼魂所缠绕。

blocks.en: Real and generated images can provide conflicting supervision for the same scene. Transient objects and cross-date appearance changes make real observations inconsistent, while independently refined views may contain incompatible structures. Fitting these targets can reinforce existing artifacts or introduce new ones.
blocks.zh: 真实和生成的图像可以为同一场景提供相冲突的监督. 瞬态对象和跨日期外观变化使得真实的观察不一致,而独立精炼的观察可能包含不相容的结构. 配合这些目标可以强化现有的文物或引进新的文物。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce CityRecast. Our approach repairs the Gaussian scene throughout generative refinement, so that recovered details can be reproduced without retaining the spatial errors behind existing artifacts. This repair also depends on consistent supervision. We therefore reduce conflicts in real and generated observations to guide scene correction and detail recovery.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了CityRecast. 我们的方法 修复高斯的场景 整个基因改良, 这样回收的细节 可以复制 而不保留 空间错误 背后 现有文物。 这种维修也取决于连贯的监督. 因此,我们减少了实际的冲突,并产生了观察,以指导现场的纠正和详细恢复。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • We propose CityRecast to suppress persistent artifacts in generative satellite 3D reconstruction. The framework combines Gaussian scene repair with calibration of real observations and joint refinement of generated views, addressing existing scene errors and conflicting supervision together. • We develop a stagewise repair strategy that begins with multi-angle warm-up to constrain elongated Gaussians using refined views. Surface-guided replacement transfers their appearance to new surface Gaussians while gradually retiring selected old ones. Observation calibration downweights transient regions and models date-dependent appearance. Geometry-guided joint refinement exchanges cross-view features and aligns structures for consistent supervision. • Experiments on six urban scenes demonstrate improved low-elevation rendering quality. CityRecast outperforms Skyfall-GS with the same generator, while surface repair produces clearer renderings than continued fitting with equal GS updates.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: CityRecast builds on generative priors for satellite reconstruction, with scene initialization and surface-guided repair supported by cross-view refinement. We review the work underlying these components, beginning with satellite reconstruction and generative supervision before turning to geometric guidance and Gaussian optimization.
blocks.zh: CityRecast基于卫星重建的基因前科,场景初始化和地表制导修复辅以交叉视图的改进. 我们审查这些组成部分的基础工作,首先是卫星重建和基因监测,然后转向几何取向和高斯优化。

blocks.en: Satellite scene reconstruction. Satellite reconstruction adapts multi-view matching to satellite camera models [ 81 , 14 ] . Neural radiance fields and 3D Gaussian Splatting offer renderable scene representations [ 41 , 25 ] , with advances in efficiency [ 74 , 50 , 6 , 42 ] and scale-aware rendering [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 77 ] . Applying these representations to satellite imagery also requires handling changes in illumination and scene content [ 82 ] . Shadow Neural Radiance Fields and Satellite Neural Radiance Field model these effects [ 10 , 39 ] , while Season-NeRF addresses seasonal appearance [ 13 ] . Recent Gaussian methods further accommodate satellite imaging geometry and sparse, multi-temporal observations [ 1 , 20 , 68 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 卫星场景重建. 卫星重建改造多景相匹配卫星相机模型[81,14]. 神经发光场和3D高斯电镀场提供了可渲染的场景表现[41,25],在效率[74,50,6,42]和有分级意识的渲染[2,3,4,77]方面都有了进步. 将这些表述应用于卫星图像还需要处理照明和场景内容的变化[82]。 阴影神经辐射场和卫星神经辐射场 现场模型这些效果[10,39],而季-NERF处理季节外观[13]. 近代高斯方法进一步适应了卫星成像几何和稀有多时观测[1,20,68,26].

blocks.en: Generative priors for reconstruction. Generative priors supplement incomplete observations by regularizing rendered patches [ 65 ] or providing generated and restored targets [ 63 , 61 , 27 , 44 ] . Correspondence-aware interactions help make these targets consistent across views [ 51 , 21 , 37 ] . Other approaches encourage consistency through joint view generation [ 15 , 86 ] or video priors [ 35 , 76 , 85 , 64 ] . In remote sensing, diffusion models also recover occluded object structure through amodal completion [ 30 ] . In satellite settings, MagicCity uses geometric guidance for city-view generation [ 71 ] , while Skyfall-GS combines observation-based geometry with diffusion priors for progressive low-elevation refinement [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 重建的基因前科。 基因前科通过使已生成的补丁规范化[65]或提供生成和恢复的目标[63,61,27,44]来补充不完整的观测. 通信意识的互动有助于使这些目标在各种观点中保持一致[51、21、37]。 其他办法通过联合取景[15、86]或视频前传[35、76、85、64]鼓励一致性。 在遥感中,扩散模型也通过amoduction [30] 恢复了被占用的物体结构. 在卫星设置中,"魔法城"使用几何取向来进行城市-视野生成[71],而"天瀑-GS"则将以观测为主的几何学与传播前作相结合来进行渐进式低地穿透精细化[29].

blocks.en: Geometric guidance. Classical pipelines combine structure from motion (SfM) with multi-view stereo (MVS) to recover cameras and scene geometry [ 48 , 49 ] . Learned MVS improves depth inference [ 72 , 54 , 53 , 11 , 83 , 19 , 38 ] , while DUSt3R, MASt3R, and VGGT extend geometric prediction to pointmaps, correspondences, and cameras [ 59 , 31 , 56 ] . Estimated geometry also guides reconstruction through signed distance representations and geometric cues [ 57 , 73 , 78 , 33 ] . Gaussian approaches similarly use geometric constraints for surface recovery [ 17 , 18 , 8 , 79 , 60 ] , and geometric estimates for initialization and optimization [ 62 , 36 , 69 , 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 几何向导. 古典管将从运动(SfM)到多视立体(MVS)的结构结合起来来取回相机和场景几何[48,49]. 所学的MVS改进了深度推论[72,54,53,11,83,19,38],而DUST3R,MAST3R,和VGGT则将几何预测扩展到指向,函证,相机[59,31,56]. 估计几何学还通过签名的距离表示和几何提示来指导重建[57,73,78,33]. 高斯方法同样使用几何限制来进行地表恢复[17,18,8,79,60],并使用几何估计来进行初始化和优化[62,36,69,16].

blocks.en: Sparse and changing observations. Sparse-view reconstruction uses learned scene priors to supplement limited observations [ 75 , 58 , 7 ] . Depth and correspondence supervision provide additional geometric constraints [ 9 , 55 , 52 ] , while regularization helps reduce overfitting [ 22 , 43 , 70 ] . Gaussian methods improve coverage and geometric constraints [ 87 , 32 , 45 , 23 ] , or reduce overfitting through pruning and dropout [ 66 , 67 ] . Multi-temporal imagery captures surface changes under varying observation conditions [ 12 ] . These differences complicate fitting a shared scene. NeRF in the Wild models appearance variation and transient content [ 40 ] . Robust fitting and uncertainty weighting instead suppress distractors [ 47 , 46 ] . Related Gaussian methods also account for appearance changes in uncontrolled captures [ 80 , 28 , 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 分和变化观察. Sparse-view重建利用所学到的场景前作补充有限观察[75,58,7]. 深度和函证监督提供了额外的几何限制[9,55,52],而规范化有助于减少过度调整[22,43,70]. 高斯方法提高了覆盖率和几何限制[87,32,45,23],或通过打压和辍学来减少过度调整[66,67]. 多时相图捕捉到不同观测条件下的地表变化[12]. 这些差异使合用共同场景变得复杂。 野生模型中的NERF外观变异和瞬态内容 [40]. 坚固的相配和不确定的分量可以抑制分心器 [47, 46]. 相關高斯方法也造成了不受控制的捕捉器外观变化 [80, 28, 34].

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
CityRecast suppresses residual artifacts in generative satellite 3D reconstruction by repairing the Gaussian distribution and improving the supervision that guides it.
Fig. 2 gives an overview. We first define the scene representation (Sec. 3.1 ), then describe real and generated supervision (Sec. 3.2 ). Finally, we introduce warm-up and surface-guided Gaussian replacement (Sec. 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We first evaluate CityRecast on DFC2019 and IARPA against existing reconstruction methods, assessing low-view rendering quality and satellite-view fidelity (Sec. 4.2 ). We further compare with Skyfall-GS using the same refinement model to examine the contribution of our reconstruction strategy. Finally, we ablate individual components to analyze their effects on rendering quality and residual artifacts (Sec. 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先根据现有的重建方法评估DFC2019和IRPA上的City Recast,评估低视差渲染质量和卫星视差的忠诚度(第4.2节)。 我们进一步与Skyfall-GS进行比较,使用同样的改进模式来审查我们重建战略的贡献。 最后,我们放弃了单个部件,以分析它们对制作质量和剩余文物的影响(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We reconstruct multiple urban scenes from DFC2019 and IARPA. Each scene is evaluated from 18 low-view cameras spanning 25 ∘ 25^{\circ} , 35 ∘ 35^{\circ} , and 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} at six azimuths. All methods use the same cameras, resolution, and crops, and are evaluated by directly rendering their final Gaussian scenes. Our comparisons include EOGS [ 1 ] , Mip-Splatting [ 77 ] , Skyfall-GS [ 29 ] , and SkySplat [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们从DFC2019和IRPA重建了多个城市场景. 每个场景由18个低视相机 横跨25分25分25分35分35分35分35分35分35分45分45分6分12分 所有方法都使用相同的相机,分辨率,和收成,通过直接渲染出其最终高斯的场景来评价. 我们的比较包括EOGS [1],Mip-Splating [77],Skyfall-GS [29],和SkySplat [20].

blocks.en: PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS measure fidelity to held-out satellite observations. For low-view renderings, we report MUSIQ [ 24 ] and compute FID-CLIP and CMMD using Google Earth imagery as distributional references. Per-scene scores are averaged equally within each dataset.
blocks.zh: PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS测量被搁置的卫星观测的可靠性。 对于低视图渲染,我们报告MUSIQ[24],并使用Google Earth图像作为发行参考计算FID-CLIP和CMMD. 每一数据集内的人均得分平均。

blocks.en: We first fit the initial Gaussians to real observations, then use multi-angle warm-up to prepare the scene for progressive refinement. Progressive refinement follows the curriculum principle of Skyfall-GS [ 29 ] , gradually lowering the viewing elevation. A final consolidation stage, like warm-up, mixes refined targets from multiple elevations to consolidate details across viewing directions. Real observations remain part of the supervision throughout training. Detailed schedules and sampling proportions are provided in Supplementary Sec. C. Each scene takes approximately 5–8 hours to train on one PRO 6000 GPU.
blocks.zh: 我们首先让最初的高斯人进行真实的观测,然后用多角热身来为场景的逐步完善做准备. 逐步完善遵循"天降-GS[29]"的课程原则,逐步降低取景高度. 最后的巩固阶段,如取暖,混合了从多高地到集成各个取景方向的细节的精细目标. 在整个培训过程中,真正的观察仍然是监督的一部分。 详细的时间表和抽样比例见补充Sec. C。 每个场景大约需要5至8小时才能在一台PRO 6000 GPU上进行训练。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Effect of surface-guided repair. The top row shows the initial rendering, extracted surface, and repaired rendering. The middle row compares the spatial extent of artifacts in the initial scene, after continued fitting, and after surface repair. The bottom row shows the corresponding cross sections within a 40 m slab. Candidates and display scales are shared across columns.
blocks.zh: 图6:地表制导修理的效果。 上行显示初始渲染,取出表面,并修复渲染. 中行比较了最初场景中,继续装配后,再进行地表修复后文物的空间范围. 下行显示40米平板内相应的横行. 候选人和显示表由各栏分享。

blocks.zh: 图7:6k GS更新后的动态修复。 交接意味着继续优化。 即时使用即时移交,而任何遗产均不忽略外观转让。 折叠的垂直行表示表面刷新时.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Ablation study on JAX164 and OMA203. Scores are averaged over the two scenes. W, C, S, and J denote warm-up, observation calibration, surface repair, and joint refinement, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表2:JAX164和OMA203的读取研究. 分数平均在两个场景上. W,C,S,和J分别表示取暖,观测校正,地表修补和联合改进.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with existing methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与现有方法的比较

blocks.en: Table 1 reports results on DFC2019 and IARPA. CityRecast outperforms the comparison methods on all six metrics in both datasets. Compared with Skyfall-GS, it reduces FID-CLIP by 25.3% on DFC2019 and 51.8% on IARPA, with lower CMMD and higher MUSIQ on both. Satellite-view metrics show modest improvements, indicating that CityRecast maintains satellite-view reconstruction fidelity while improving low-view rendering quality.
blocks.zh: 表1报告了DFC2019和IRPA的结果。 CityRecast 超越了两个数据集中所有6个度量的比较方法. 与Skyfall-GS相比,它在DFC2019上将FID-CLIP减少了25.3%,在IRPA上减少了51.8%,两者都降低了CMMD和更高的MUSIQ. 卫星视标显示略有改进,表明CityRecast保持卫星视标重建忠心,同时提高低视标渲染质量.

blocks.en: Fig. 4 compares direct Gaussian renderings across six scenes. CityRecast substantially reduces visible artifacts and blur relative to all four baselines, producing sharper building boundaries and clearer facade details. EOGS and Mip-Splatting exhibit smeared surfaces and elongated artifacts that obscure scene content, while SkySplat shows rippled surfaces and fragmented structures. Skyfall-GS recovers more coherent scene layouts, but facade patterns and roof edges remain visibly blurred. In JAX 214, CityRecast reveals more distinct vertical facade divisions and sharper roof edges around the tower. Roof outlines and gaps between buildings are also clearer in OMA 287, while the IARPA scenes show better separation of buildings, vegetation, and surrounding ground. The Google Earth references also help identify structures obscured in the baselines, such as the sports field and nearby buildings in OMA 203. CityRecast renders their boundaries more distinctly.
blocks.zh: 图4比较了高斯的直接渲染跨越了六个场景. CityRecast大大地减少了可见文物,与所有四个基线相比模糊不清,产生了更尖锐的建筑界限和更清晰的外观细节. EOGS和Mip-Splating展出被涂抹的表面和被长长的文物,模糊了场景内容;而SkySplatz则展示出被撕裂的表面和被打碎的结构. Skyfall-GS恢复了更连贯的场景布局,但外表图案和屋顶边缘仍然明显模糊. 在JAX 214中,CityRecast揭示出更明显的垂直外观分出和塔周围更锋利的屋顶边缘. 在OMA 287中,屋顶轮廓和建筑物之间的隔阂也比较清楚,而IARPA的场景显示建筑物,植被和周围地貌的分化较好. Google Earth参考文献还帮助识别基线所隐含的结构,例如OMA 203的体育场和附近的建筑. 城市重组使其边界更加明确。

blocks.en: To examine the contribution of the reconstruction strategy, we replace the original Skyfall-GS refiner with the FLUX.2 [klein] 4B used by CityRecast. The rest of the Skyfall-GS pipeline remains unchanged. Fig. 5 shows that residual streaks still obscure parts of the facade in this control. CityRecast reveals clearer structural detail with the same generator, illustrating the benefit of its reconstruction strategy.
blocks.zh: 为了检查重建战略的贡献,我们用CityRecast使用的FLUX.2 [klein] 4B取代了原来的Skyfall-GS精炼器. Skyfall-GS管道的其余部分保持不变。 图5显示,残余的花纹 仍然模糊了外表的部分 在这个控制。 CityRecast用同一个发电机揭示了更清晰的结构细节,说明了其重建战略的好处.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation and analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析和分析

blocks.en: Table 2 evaluates the contribution of each component by removing it from the full pipeline. Observation calibration is ablated as a whole, including both transient weighting and date-conditioned appearance modeling.
blocks.zh: 表2通过从整个管道中删除每个组成部分来评价其贡献。 观测校正整体上呈减速状态,包括瞬态加权和日期条件外观模型.

blocks.en: For row (a), we replace multi-angle warm-up with high-elevation refinement using the same number of GS updates. Both variants then follow the same subsequent training schedule. The replacement configuration is provided in Supplementary Sec. C. Without warm-up, FID-CLIP increases from 23.36 to 30.73 and MUSIQ drops from 67.42 to 57.33, the largest degradation in low-view quality among the ablations. PSNR and LPIPS also deteriorate. With the same number of GS updates, multi-angle warm-up provides a better starting point for subsequent training than continued fitting at high elevation. Supplementary Sec. D provides a separate comparison with continued fitting under matched GS-update budgets, showing RGB renderings and digital surface model (DSM) visualizations.
blocks.zh: 对于(a)行,我们使用同样数目的GS更新,用高连通度改进取代多角热身. 两个变体随后都遵循了相同的后续训练时间表. 更换配置在补充Sec.C.中提供。 没有暖和,FID-CLIP从23.36个增加到30.73个,MUSIQ从67.42个减少到57.33个,这是堆积物中低视差最大的退化。 PSNR和LPIPS也恶化了. 由于GS更新次数相同,多角暖身为随后的培训提供了一个更好的起点,而不是继续适应高地。 补充秘书。 D提供了与在相应的GS更新预算下继续安装的单独比较,显示RGB渲染和数字表面模型可视化。

blocks.en: Removing calibration lowers PSNR from 18.57 to 17.29 dB and raises LPIPS from 0.317 to 0.411, with a corresponding deterioration in low-view quality. A related failure is visible in the parking areas of Fig. 5 , where the Skyfall-GS control contains dense ghosting and streaks extending into nearby structures. Vehicles present on different dates can be absorbed into the GS as persistent content. Subsequent generative refinement can reinforce and reshape these remnants, spreading artifacts beyond their original locations. CityRecast instead shows cleaner parking surfaces, distinct lane markings, and less clutter around the buildings. Additional examples of transient observation calibration are shown in Supplementary Sec. D.
blocks.zh: 删除校正将PSNR从18.57降低到17.29 dB,将LPIPS从0.317提升到0.411,低视质量也相应恶化. 相关的故障在图5的停车区可见,天瀑-GS控制包含密集的幽灵并延伸至附近的建筑. 不同日期的车辆可作为持久性内容被吸收到GS中. 随后的基因改良可以加强并重塑这些残余物,将文物扩散出出原地. 城市改造则显示更清洁的停车地表、明显的车道标志以及建筑物周围较少的杂乱之处。 短暂观测校正的其他例子见补充Sec. D.

blocks.en: Removing surface repair raises FID-CLIP from 23.36 to 28.93, while PSNR decreases by only 0.15 dB (Table 2 ). This difference is more evident in Fig. 6 . Although the satellite-view fitting scores change only modestly, surface repair substantially improves the low-view appearance. Starting from the same initial GS, we compare continued fitting with surface repair after 1,800 additional GS updates in each case. Continued fitting leaves elongated Gaussian structures and the resulting veiling largely intact, whereas surface repair reduces their spatial extent and reveals clearer facade detail. At the same update budget, surface repair reduces residual artifacts more effectively than continued fitting.
blocks.zh: 拆除地表修理使FID-CLIP从23.36升至28.93,而PSNR只减少0.15分贝(表2)。 这种差异在图6中更为明显。 虽然卫星取景配对的分数变化不大,但地表修复大大改进了低取景外观. 从相同的最初GS开始,我们将每例1 800个补充GS更新后的持续安装与地表修理进行比较。 持续的接合叶被延长了高斯结构,由此产生的遮盖基本完好无损,而地表修复则会缩小其空间范围并揭示出更清晰的外观细节. 在同样的更新预算中,地表修复比继续安装更有效地减少了剩余文物.

blocks.en: Fig. 7 further examines appearance inheritance and progressive handover. Without appearance inheritance, surface refresh causes a pronounced drop in satellite-view PSNR. Full repair limits this disruption and achieves the highest low-view MUSIQ by the end of optimization. Continued fitting retains slightly higher PSNR but yields substantially lower low-view quality.
blocks.zh: 图7进一步审查了外观继承和逐步移交。 没有外观继承,地表刷新会导致卫星视野PSNR明显下降. 完全修复限制了这种干扰,并在最优化结束前实现了最高的低视图MUSIQ. 继续安装保留了略高的PSNR,但收视率低得多。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Effect of joint refinement on generated supervision. Views A and B compare independent Klein outputs with jointly refined targets after ten online updates; highlighted regions mark corresponding roof structures.
blocks.zh: 图8:联合改进对产生的监督的影响。 视图 A和B在10个在线更新后,将独立的克莱因产出与共同完善的目标进行比较;突出的区域标出相应的屋顶结构。

blocks.en: To ablate J, we use independent Klein 4B outputs without online adaptation, keeping the view count and sampling steps unchanged. Joint refinement improves low-view FID-CLIP and MUSIQ, accompanied by a slight decrease in satellite-view fidelity. Given our focus on low-elevation rendering, we favor this improvement in perceptual quality. Fig. 8 illustrates the effect on generated supervision. Independent refinement produces incompatible roof structures in the two views, whereas joint refinement better aligns the highlighted structures after ten online updates.
blocks.zh: 为了降低J,我们使用独立的Klein 4B输出而不进行在线修改,保持视图计数和采样步骤不变. 联合改进改进了低视距FID-CLIP和MUSIQ,同时卫星视忠度也略有下降。 鉴于我们注重低触感渲染,我们赞成提高感知质量。 图8说明了对产生的监督的影响。 独立改进在两种观点中产生不相容的屋顶结构,而联合改进则在10个在线更新后更好地协调突出的结构。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: CityRecast suppresses persistent artifacts in generative satellite reconstruction through early multi-angle correction and continued surface-guided repair. Observation calibration and joint refinement support this repair by reducing conflicts in real and generated supervision. Experiments across six urban scenes show reduced ghosting, streaking, and blur in direct GS renderings. Building boundaries and facade details become clearer, while satellite-view fidelity is maintained. These results highlight the importance of repairing the underlying Gaussian scene alongside improving generated supervision. However, visually plausible facades in weakly observed regions may still differ from the actual buildings. Future work will focus on reducing runtime and improving the faithfulness of low-elevation facade reconstruction to real structures.
blocks.zh: CityRecast通过早期多角校正和持续的地表制导修复,压制了基因卫星重建中的持久性文物. 观察校正和联合改进有助于通过减少实际和产生的监督方面的冲突来进行修复。 6个城市场景的实验显示, 鬼魂化,花纹化, 和模糊的直接GS渲染。 建筑界限和外表细节变得更加清晰,而卫星观测忠心则得到保持。 这些结果突出表明,在改善产生的监督的同时,必须修复基本的高斯风景。 然而,在观察不力的地区,视似可信的外观仍可能与实际建筑不同。 今后的工作将侧重于减少运行时间,使低地外墙重建更加忠实于实际结构。
